subject.title: Feature: Auto-leave WhatsApp groups not in allowlist + group-join webhook

question: Should OpenClaw add WhatsApp unauthorized-group auto-leave and group-add notification as an opt-in WhatsApp plugin feature now, and what trigger and authorization contract should it use?
rationale: The requested behavior is missing, but automatic or manual group leaving changes a security boundary and introduces destructive account behavior plus new config/event surfaces.

options.title: Design Opt-In WhatsApp Contract First
options.body: Define group admission, join-event, account/target authorization, audit, and leave semantics before implementing the WhatsApp plugin behavior.

options.title: Defer To Shared Group Pairing
options.body: Keep this issue open and align it with the broader group-pairing design before adding a WhatsApp-specific hook or leave behavior.

options.title: Keep Allowlist-Only Posture
options.body: Document that unauthorized WhatsApp groups are dropped or blocked and require manual cleanup rather than adding auto-leave behavior.

recommendation.title: Design Opt-In WhatsApp Contract First
recommendation.body: Define group admission, join-event, account/target authorization, audit, and leave semantics before implementing the WhatsApp plugin behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest available signal from current blame and prior issue review across the WhatsApp config/runtime/security surface.
